checks.explanation: U.S. real GDP growth has not reached the predicted 4-5% annual pace; growth has remained in the roughly 2-3% range through 2025-2026 despite DOGE's deregulation push.
No flat tax or comparable dramatic tax-code simplification was enacted, and no corresponding 1-2 percentage point GDP growth boost materialized.
Confirmed: DOGE officially shut down on July 4, 2026, exactly the date Sacks cited (though it had effectively wound down as a centralized entity months earlier in November 2025).

sources.title: DOGE's official July 4 expiration date leaves a lasting legacy

checks.explanation: The predicted 4-8 year window (through roughly 2028-2032) hasn't elapsed, so a clear pattern of MAGA-aligned primary challenges against anti-MAGA Republican incumbents can't yet be fully assessed.

No source indicates David Sacks has had any notable involvement with Dogecoin specifically; his post-administration crypto/AI role (White House czar, then PCAST co-chair) covered broad digital-asset policy, not a Dogecoin-specific partnership or investment.
